p: flesh: Whose seed either in sleeping or else of weakness of nature issues at his secret part.
his uncleanness: Of the thing of which he shall be unclean.
he shall wash his clothes: Of whom the unclean man did spit.
saddle soever he rideth upon that: The word signifies every thing on which a man rides.
cleansed of his issue: That is, be restored to his old state, and be healed of it.
flesh in water: Meaning, all his body.
her separation shall be unclean: That is, when she has her period, by which she is separate from her husband, from the tabernacle and from touching any holy thing.
be upon him: If any of her uncleanness touched him in the bed: for else the man that companied with such a woman should die, 20:18.
bed of her separation: Shall be unclean as the bed on which she lay when she had her natural disease.
number to herself seven days: After the time that she is recovered.

separate the children of Israel from: Seeing that God required purity and cleanliness of his own: we cannot be his, unless our filth and sins are purged with the blood of Jesus Christ, and so we learn to detest all sin.
